title: HOSA Nutrition: Medical Nutrition Therapy - Nutrition - Medical Nutrition Therapy - Enteral Nutrition
subject: Nutrition

questions.q: A patient in the ICU requires enteral nutrition but has a high risk of aspiration. Which tube placement is generally preferred to reduce this risk?
questions.explain: Feeding into the jejunum (post-pyloric) reduces the risk of reflux and aspiration compared to feeding into the stomach (NG or PEG), as it bypasses the pyloric sphincter.
